records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue: Revenue decreased $59.0 million, or 33.8%, to $115.7 million for the three months ended March 31, 2025 from $174.7 million for the three months ended March 31, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: While the average revenue per active earning OPTAVIA coach has been declining year-over-year since the third quarter of 2022 due to lower sales volumes, we continue to see lower year-over-year declines in this key metric, driven in part by increased productivity of newer coach cohorts.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities decreased by $3.9 million to $3.4 million for the three months ended March 31, 2025 from $7.3 million for the three months ended March 31, 2024 primarily driven by a $9.1 million decrease in net income, a $5.3 million decrease related to changes in inventory balances partially offset by a $9.9 million decrease in accounts payable and accrued expenses.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cost of sales: Cost of sales decreased $16.0 million, or 33.6%, to $31.5 million from $47.4 million for the three months ended March 31, 2025 from the corresponding period in 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: (Loss) income from operations: The Company’s loss from operations for the three months ended March 31, 2025 was $1.3 million, a decrease of $9.2 million as compared to income from operations of $7.9 million for the corresponding period in 2024, primarily as a result of decreased gross profit partially offset by decreased SG&A expenses.
